A Welcome Change Now and Again
Nov 2016 • Couples
I have mixed feelings about the India Palace - the staff are lovely, the building is smart and it has a lovely view; the starters are always delicious but occasionally the main courses vary. The masala papadams are consistently spicy and tasty as are their delicious sauces and bread, and my husband swears by the crispy Chicken 65. We both also love the starter which has green chilis with a spicy cheese inside. I can't remember the name of the dish but it is one of the best Indian starters we have ever tasted anywhere. It's just that the main courses vary so much . Occasionally they are all very delicious - we normally have Chicken Vindaloo or Jalfrazi although we occasionally have the Kadai or try another dish from the menu. But sometimes they are not so tasty or have an overriding flavour of what I think might be cumin which is all then that I am aware of. It's a pity because there have been many other nights when the food is absolutely delicious from start to finish. So it is definitely a place I will call into occasionally but there are many other Indian restaurants to enjoy out there in-between.

Not original India Palace
Mar 2017 • Couples
First of all the India Palace I know when I used to visit them 2010-2011. It was located at a different place, close to 76 Xuan Dieu. It was out and out a South Indian restaurant with good food, ambiance and friendly people. When I visited them this time in March, 2017 the place was deserted and the Menu has totally changed from South Indian Food to North Indian food. I did not try this joint as after 2-3 visits as I live close by, I always found it deserted and hence did not have the heart to sit there and try out as this could be risky from old and reheated food kept in the fridge.
